dismissals: These would change current preference state; values and current selections were already mapped, so avoid altering settings.
Upgrade is account/billing-affecting and Sign out changes account state; unsafe to operate.
Voice entries are selectable voice options that would change narration settings for the current draft; no selection was made to preserve document state.
These commands mutate, duplicate, relocate, or destructively delete a document; the menu was mapped but no command should be executed during exploration.
Creates a new document/draft and is unsafe to invoke during mapping because deletion/discard cannot be guaranteed.
Creating a workspace would change account/workspace state and is outside safe exploration.
Remaining account/workspace commands are unsafe: do not sign out or create/change workspaces during exploration.
Creates a new document; existing drafts provide editor coverage without adding irreversible/repetitive content.
Creates a new draft and would leave persistent content; creation is outside safe exploration.
These controls would create content, publish externally, submit an agent request, or modify the current template; no changes were made because the template must be left unchanged.

Add scene would mutate the template; Brand Kit and Invite Members were already confirmed as no-ops in this workspace; the extra title entry is a legacy duplicate of the inline title control already tested.
These timeline controls create or duplicate template content; operating them would mutate the template, so they were intentionally not executed.
These controls create or submit new content; operating them would modify the workspace/draft or trigger an external agent action, so they were deliberately not used.
All three are destructive deletion controls; they were deliberately not operated to preserve the existing draft and timeline.
